Position Summary

Odyssey Systems has an exciting opportunity for a Principal Program Manager
providing support to the Command, Control, Communications, and Battle Management Division (C3BM) .

Command, Control, Communications, and Battle Management (C3BM) has been tasked with delivering an integrated Department of the Air Force (DAF) Battle Network providing resilient decision advantage and enabling the USAF, USSF, Joint, and Coalition Force to win against the pacing challenge. C3BM supports execution in many different focus areas. C3BM’s main efforts are Architecture and Systems Engineering (ASE), Operational Response Team (ORT), and multiple mission integration teams such as Air, Maritime and multiple acquisitions consisting of both the Advanced Battle Management System (ABMS) and Space.

The DAF BATTLE NETWORK is the integrated system-of-systems fusing sensors, effectors, and sustainment grids to build situational awareness, make operational decisions, and direct the force to create needed lethal and nonlethal effects in support of the Joint Force Commander’s scheme of maneuver. The DAF PEO C3BM has the responsibility of technically and programmatically integrating the DAF’s larger system-of-systems architecture needed to deliver an integrated Command and Control (C2) core function for the DAF, Joint, and Coalition forces, by teaming with all other DAF PEOs, as needed.

As the team responsible for governing Capital One’s entire model portfolio, the Model Risk Office (MROf) plays a critical role in enabling the long-term, sustainable success of Capital One – especially as the enterprise (and world) becomes increasingly reliant on ever-more-complicated models! As a CoS Project Manager on the Chief of Staff team, you will be responsible for shaping the internal management operations of our >200 associate organization, as well as providing organizational leverage to senior leadership. This is a ‘high visibility’ role that will be instrumental in maximizing the overall impact and effectiveness of the Model Risk Management organization, and can be considered an ‘Assistant Chief of Staff’ opportunity for professionals interested in growing their general management toolkit.

The CoS Project Manager will play a key role in the design and well-managed execution of:

Budget and headcount management processes
Annual strategic planning
Coordinating preparation cycles for key leadership ceremonies, including: Monthly Business Reviews, Town Halls, quarterly regulatory reviews, executive leadership forums, board reporting, and other cross-functional working groups
Stakeholder engagement and transparency strategy/ agenda – to ensure well-orchestrated delivery of key strategic priorities
Talent strategy and management cycles
Lead or support other special projects as they arise, based on business needs

Self-motivated, reliable, and resourceful multitasker with solid time management and prioritization skills
Deep sense of ownership, responsibility, and attention to detail; with a high bar for quality
Highly organized; with strong project management toolkit and process orientation
Strong verbal and written communication (lots of writing)
Comfortable building and maintaining positive relationships with VP+ executive leaders
Collaborative and team-first mentality

At least 3 years of project management, process management, or event management experience

2+ years of experience with direct senior/executive leadership interaction and support
2+ years of experience in Consulting or other project-based strategy or transformation roles
Strong oral and written communication skills
Prior experience with second-line Business Risk organizations and concepts, such as Model Risk

every day, for our clients, our people, and our communities through industry-focused wealth advisory, digital, audit, tax, consulting, and outsourcing services. Even with more than 8,500 people, 130 U.S. locations, and a global reach, we promise to know you and help you.

CLA is growing and seeking to hire an experienced Program Manager
to join our talented Information Technology team. The position offers growth, flexibility and a collaborative work environment.

In this position you should have the following; excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate at all levels. Strong problem solving and creative skills and the ability to exercise sound judgment. Most important, demonstrate a high level of integrity and dependability with a strong sense of urgency and results-orientation.

This role is responsible for implementing and overseeing multiple projects, ensuring they align with the firm’s strategic goals.

How you’ll create opportunities in this Program Manager role:

Solutions Initiatives and Program Planning: Collaborate with different teams to enable the delivery of firmwide solutions that accomplish business goals and objectives. Develop and manage program plans, including defining scope, objectives, and deliverables. Ensure successful delivery across all project/product teams within the Enterprise program. Provide direction and overall program leadership to project teams. Partner with the business and product manager to ensure the program is meeting the strategic direction of the firm.
Project Management and Integration: Own Program Governance and Controls (i.e., Steering Committees, Advisory Boards). Coach project leads and teams in project methodology (i.e., Scrum Teams in Lean-Agile practices and mindsets). Responsible for alignment of program 5 year vision and roadmap with business leadership. Optimize delivery flow and process improvement, and assist in reporting, tracking, and execution of project milestones (i.e., Value Stream, Epics, and Features). Understand and coordinate project/program interdependencies and facilitate the escalation of risks, issues, and impediments. Oversee program and product budgets as well as third-party vendors. Ensure a seamless transition from project to appropriate team structures (i.e., product manager, governance team, etc.).
Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand their needs and expectations. Maintain effective communication and manage relationships throughout the program lifecycle.
Resource Management: Allocate resources effectively to ensure project success. Monitor resource utilization and make adjustments as necessary
Portfolio and Program Management: Lead Portfolio and Program Management activities to ensure organizational investments align with strategic objectives and deliver business value. Partner with business leaders to validate priorities, provide visibility into demand, and support enterprise-wide prioritization to ensure the organization is focused on the right work. Collaborate with technical teams, architects, project managers, and business stakeholders to align dependencies, coordinate delivery plans, remove obstacles, and drive execution of complex initiatives. Provide mentorship, coaching, and leadership to project managers while promoting consistent project and program management practices across the organization.

8 years relevant experience required
6 years of project management and/or supervisory experience preferred.
Bachelor's degree or a combination of relevant experience and training may be considered in lieu of a degree.

Experience with Microsoft Office, Microsoft Project, Azure Dev Ops and SharePoint.
Comprehensive understanding and experience leading application development projects.
Comfortable using a large variety of technology tools and able to easily adapt to rapidly changing technology

new_jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager III (6793)
new_jobs.description:
As Sr. Program Manager III
, you’ll lead the delivery of a complex, mission-focused technology program. You will bring together people, technology, operations, financial management, and customer engagement to ensure teams deliver measurable outcomes while maintaining strong performance and stakeholder trust.
We know that you can’t have great technology services without amazing people. At MetroStar, we are obsessed
with
our people and have led a two-decade legacy of building the best and brightest teams. Because we know our future relies on our deep understanding and relentless focus on our people, we live by our mission: A passion for our people. Value for our customers.
If you think you can see yourself delivering our mission and pursuing our goals with us, then check out the job description below!
What you’ll do:

Program Leadership: Provide overall leadership, direction, and accountability for the successful delivery of a large-scale IT program, ensuring technical, operational, contractual, and financial objectives align with organizational and mission priorities.
Customer Engagement: Serve as the primary interface with client and organizational leadership and key stakeholders, maintaining strong customer relationships, communicating program performance, and proactively addressing priorities, concerns, and emerging requirements.
Program Execution: Plan, coordinate, and oversee program activities across cloud engineering, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, network operations, service delivery, and other technical workstreams to ensure integrated and successful execution.
Performance Management: Establish and monitor program performance metrics, service-level objectives, key performance indicators (KPIs), deliverables, and milestones to ensure contractual requirements and customer expectations are achieved.
Financial Management: Manage program budgets, forecasts, staffing, resource allocation, and financial performance while identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency and maximize value to the customer.
Risk & Issue Management: Identify and manage program risks, issues, dependencies, and opportunities while developing mitigation strategies and ensuring timely escalation and resolution of critical challenges.
Workforce Management: Lead multidisciplinary teams of technical experts, engineers, architects, cybersecurity professionals, and operational personnel while ensuring appropriate staffing, performance, professional development, and workforce continuity.
Contract & Deliverable Management: Ensure contract requirements, deliverables, reporting obligations, and performance standards are met while maintaining alignment with applicable applicable policies, processes, and acquisition requirements.
Continuous Improvement: Establish processes that improve service delivery, operational maturity, automation, quality, and customer satisfaction throughout the program lifecycle.
Executive Communications: Develop and deliver program reviews, executive briefings, performance reports, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to client and corporate leadership.

What you’ll need to succeed:

Active Secret security clearance.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
15+ years of experience managing complex IT, cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, or digital modernization programs.
8+ years of experience leading large-scale programs supporting large enterprise, public sector, or regulated customers.
Demonstrated experience managing multidisciplinary technical teams across cloud, cybersecurity, network, infrastructure, enterprise architecture, and IT operations.
Experience managing program budgets, staffing plans, schedules, subcontractors, deliverables, performance metrics, risks, and contractual requirements.
Strong understanding of contracting, acquisition, and delivery processes, performance management, and customer engagement.
Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and coordinate technical and business activities across multiple organizations and stakeholders.
Experience establishing and monitoring KPIs, SLAs, operational metrics, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Strong executive communication, leadership, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate effectively with senior client and corporate leadership.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
ITIL, Agile, SAFe, or equivalent program/service management certification preferred.
Experience leading cloud modernization, Zero Trust, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, or enterprise IT transformation programs preferred.

Adobe stands out as a top player in customer intelligence. We have solutions to empower our enterprises to understand their customers as people – what they want, need, and believe and to leverage insights to help business deliver the most delightful customer experiences.

Our engineering team is responsible for uniquely poised to offer its services to build solutions to bring the delightful experience and intelligence in a far superior way which otherwise would not have been to manage and bring value to our customers. We help them make sense of that data, glean insights and run algorithms, so they can deliver delightful experiences in real-time, every time.

Building a robust fault tolerant and highly available system at very high scale while providing ease and convenience to disparate solutions and enterprise customer team is a key to our success. We use Big Data, Open source technologies and home grown solutions to develop various services for Adobe Solutions, Customers and Partners.

We support very large enterprise products to support their customers spread across geographies. This requires disparate data sources and ingestion mechanism. Proven ability to manage ambiguity and provide clear direction in dynamic, rapidly evolving technology landscapes
Experience managing global, cross functional programs and assignments within matrixed organizations
Familiarity with or experience working in startup or high growth environments, where new technologies and experimentation are central to success
Exceptional critical thinking combined with strong operational execution, ensuring alignment between long term AI strategy and near term deliverables
Excellent communication, presentation and executive presence skills to engage with senior leadership and diverse customer groups

new_jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Overview

The Office of the CTO (OCTO) for Microsoft is chartered with understanding, shaping, and accelerating technologies and their impact across Microsoft, industry, and society. OCTO leads investments in emerging technical bets, provides technical insights, and drives high-priority company-wide AI initiatives, while partnering with our engineering, field, and strategy teams. As part of this, OCTO is responsible for Microsoft’s technical strategy for the use of OpenAI technology across Microsoft. OCTO operates as a high‑leverage organization – partnering deeply across engineering, product, research, and leadership to influence technical direction, execution integrity, and long‑term strategy.

We are seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager (TPM)
to lead Simultaneous Shipping (SimShip) for a strategic Microsoft AI partnership. In this role, you will orchestrate complex global releases across engineering, product, compliance, and partner teams to deliver high-quality experiences across markets, languages, and regulatory environments. This work moves at the pace of AI and requires strong judgment, coordination, and execution.

This is a high-visibility role at the intersection of engineering execution and business impact. You will operate in an environment of significant scale and ambiguity, bringing clarity, alignment, and operational excellence to deliver consistently and responsibly for customers worldwide. You will also help ensure these AI releases meet Microsoft's Responsible AI expectations and governance requirements.

You will work closely with a key external partner and internal Microsoft stakeholders across multiple organizations to drive synchronized delivery, readiness, and customer success. Success in this role requires the ability to influence across organizational boundaries, adapt quickly to evolving AI requirements, and help Microsoft deliver with speed and quality. We are looking for candidates who demonstrate regular use of AI tools and workflows to accelerate execution and improve operational effectiveness.

Skills

Conflict Resolution
Stakeholder Management
Agility
Strategic Thinking
Technical Domain Knowledge and Skills
Program Management

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more, and we’re dedicated to this mission across every aspect of our company. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. Join us and help shape the future of the world.

Responsibilities

Program Leadership & Delivery

Lead end-to-end SimShip program execution, ensuring alignment across global release timelines, milestones, and deliverables
Drive clarity in ambiguous, fast-evolving environments; create structured plans to ensure predictable delivery
Establish and manage the release rhythm of business (ROB), including ship readiness reviews, checkpoints, and executive reporting

Cross-Company And Partner Coordination

Partner with engineering, product, localization, compliance, and operations teams across Microsoft and with a key strategic partner
Drive alignment across organizational boundaries to deliver synchronized releases at global scale
Manage dependencies across multiple systems, services, and teams to ensure coordinated delivery

Global Release Readiness (SimShip)

Own readiness across all dimensions of SimShip, including:
Localization and global availability
Regulatory and compliance readiness
Service health, reliability, and performance

Identify and proactively mitigate risks that could impact release timelines or quality

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

Define and track key operations metrics (e.g., release readiness, defect trends, coverage, quality benchmarks)
Drive continuous improvements to release processes, tooling, and cross-team collaboration
Implement scalable mechanisms to support future global releases

Stakeholder Communication & Influence

Communicate clearly and effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership
Influence decision-making through data-driven insights and structured recommendations
Provide transparent, actionable updates on program status, risks, and mitigations

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree AND 6+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree AND 12+ years experience engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience.
3+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.
1+ year(s) of experience reading and/or writing code (e.g., sample documentation, product demos).
Experience building, shipping, or operating AI services or products, including SimShip and global release execution across engineering, compliance, localization, and operational readiness functions.
Strong technical foundation with the ability to engage in architectural and system-level discussions and drive execution across complex technical environments.
Proven ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced environments while driving clarity, prioritization, and alignment across diverse stakeholders.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and executive influence skills, with the ability to lead through influence across internal and external partner teams.

Technical Program Management IC5 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $142,800 - $274,800 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $188,000 - $304,200 per year.

Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here:

https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/us-corporate-pay

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager I - Enterprise
new_jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.
At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact
Location:
We are hiring in all Axon hub sites. When staff is not traveling, they are expected to be in the office at least 1 day a week.
Travel:
30-50% (domestic) - onsite with Enterprise customers
Reports to:
Sr Director of Professional Service, Enterprise

As a Senior Technical Program Manager at Axon, you will lead the delivery of complex, enterprise-scale deployments for our Strategic Enterprise customers that operate around the globe. You’ll own programs end-to-end—partnering with customers, product, engineering, and delivery teams to translate complex requirements into clear plans and successful outcomes.

This role operates in high-visibility, mission-critical environments where priorities evolve and judgment matters. You’ll bring structure to ambiguity, maintain composure under pressure, and drive alignment across diverse stakeholders—balancing customer needs, product capabilities, and long-term scalability.

Success in this role comes from a strong sense of ownership, disciplined execution, and a genuine connection to Axon’s mission to protect life. If you thrive on solving complex problems at scale and delivering technology that makes a real-world impact, this role is for you.

Axon’s Enterprise customers depend on technology that works in high-stakes, real-world environments. This role ensures complex, multi-product deployments are delivered reliably, adopted successfully, and scaled with confidence.
As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you sit at the intersection of customer trust, execution, and mission impact—turning complexity into clarity and ensuring Axon’s technology delivers when it matters most.

What You’ll Do

Own end-to-end delivery of complex, enterprise-scale programs for Strategic and Global customers, driving execution from planning through deployment, acceptance, and adoption.
Lead multiple high-impact programs simultaneously, maintaining disciplined control over scope, timeline, dependencies, and risk in dynamic environments.
Partner closely with Product and Engineering to translate customer and regulatory requirements into executable delivery plans, making informed tradeoffs when constraints arise.
Serve as a trusted program lead for customers and internal stakeholders—bringing clarity, confidence, and calm leadership in high-stakes situations.
Drive alignment across Sales, PSO, Engineering, Product, and external partners, ensuring teams are focused on the work that matters most.
Anticipate risks and constraints early, surface them clearly, and act decisively to mitigate issues before they impact delivery or customer trust.
Lead program-level change management, adapting plans as requirements evolve while maintaining momentum and accountability.
Communicate complex technical and operational topics with precision—tailoring messaging for executive, technical, and frontline audiences.
Champion continuous improvement by identifying delivery gaps, refining processes, and helping scale repeatable, enterprise-ready execution models.
Contribute to a team-first culture by mentoring peers, sharing lessons learned, and raising the bar for program execution across the organization.

What You Bring
10+ years of experience leading complex technical programs in enterprise SaaS, hardware-enabled platforms, or mission-critical environments.
Proven track record delivering large-scale, multi-stakeholder deployments for enterprise or global customers.
Program management fundamentals, including scope, schedule, risk, dependency, and change management.
Experience partnering cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Services to drive aligned execution.
Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving environments, making sound decisions without complete information.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for executive, technical, and customer audiences.
Demonstrated capability managing multiple programs simultaneously while maintaining focus on priorities and outcomes.
Analytical and problem-solving skills, with a bias toward practical, scalable solutions.
Experience identifying and implementing process improvements that improve delivery quality and customer outcomes.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience; PMP certification preferred.
Successfully lead complex, enterprise-scale programs for Strategic and Global customers with predictable, high-quality delivery.
Operate with ownership and sound judgment, bringing clarity and calm to ambiguous, high-pressure situations.
Builds trust with customers and cross-functional partners through clear communication, proactive risk management, and consistent execution.
Navigates change effectively while maintaining momentum and alignment across teams.
Contributes to scalable delivery practices and raises the bar for program execution across the organization.

  Benefits that Benefit You
Competitive salary and 401k with employer match
Discretionary paid time off
Paid parental leave for all
Medical, Dental, Vision plans
Fitness Programs
Emotional & Mental Wellness support
Learning & Development programs
Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)
And yes, we have snacks in our offices

Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.

Axon is a total compensation company, meaning compensation is made up of base pay, bonus, and stock awards. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: level, function, training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, geographic market, and often a combination of all these factors. Our benefits offer an array of options to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. To see more details on our benefits offerings please visit https://www.axon.com/careers.
Base Pay Range: $131,250 USD - $210,000 USD
Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. Project Manager – Electrification & Automation

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

The Electrification and Automation (EA) Business Unit offers the full range of energy distribution systems and solutions for all markets and through all sales channels. We provide reliable power distribution grids of today while investing into our Future Grids portfolio and applications to create the power distribution grid of the future. Our comprehensive portfolio meets the growing technical requirements of todays and tomorrow’s power grid!

The Siemens Project Management Office (PMO) is looking for a Project Manager (PM) to join our team in Electrification and Automation (EA). The Electrification & Automation business unit covers the entire spectrum for power distribution systems and solutions as well as products for protection technology, station automation, telecontrol technology, power quality, smart communication and microgrids. As a PM, you will be responsible for the successful execution of projects, from project initiation through final closeout. You will work in a matrix style organization requiring excellent coordination skills and the ability to manage competing priorities. The PM role comes with ample opportunities for growth, reflective of Siemens’ mission to empower people with a growth mindset. This position will prefer candidates willing to work hybrid in the Wendell, NC area. Relocation assistance can be discussed.

You’ll make an impact as you:

Direct all phases of projects from inception through completion.
Manage the cost, schedule, quality, and technical performance of the assigned project(s).
Establish milestones and monitor adherence to master plans and schedules.
Effectively communicate project expectations to team members and stakeholders in a timely and clear fashion.
Lead and drive multi-disciplinary and cross functional teams, including engineering, operations, vendor management, logistics and services to ensure successful project execution.
Provide regular updates to team, management, and PMO on work performed, plans, budget, and overall status.
Identify project problems and obtain solutions, such as allocation of resources or changing contractual specifications.
Proactive Risk identification and Mitigation.
Manage customer expectations across project cycle and lead single and multi-product medium voltage solutions projects.
Direct diagnostics with the ability to determine root cause and corrective actions.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited university or college
3+ years of experience in the power distribution industry managing medium voltage portfolios.
3+ years of experience utilizing Microsoft Office and specifically Microsoft Project
1+ year of working with multi-disciplinary teams, including program management, services, engineering, operations, and logistics
Must have a valid US Driver’s License
Ability to travel up to 20% (domestic and international)
Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or electrical engineering
Project management or engineering internship or related work experience in Power distribution industry.
Basic knowledge and understanding of power distribution; ability to read and understand basic electrical drawings and customer specifications.
Experience in identifying and implementing cost savings measures within project
Commitment to develop, drive, and manage projects in a highly competitive market
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, to present complex issues to multi-level audiences and effectively communicate progress, status and issues to internal and external Customers
Ability to interpret and report results to senior management as well as customer
Demonstrated ability in contract and change management.
PMP certification as a plus
PMP certification is required within 1 year of employment

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers.

We value your unique identity and perspective. Serve as the focal point for receiving, processing, distributing, and controlling all classified documentation (hard copy and electronic media) entering or leaving the facility, including electronic data transfer.
Prepare, review and process personnel security clearance requests.
Implement visitor control procedures ensuring compliance with National Policy

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

Control Room Solutions provide the backbone for emergency response in the UK & Europe. Our applications help 999 operators respond to calls from the public and dispatch out nearby responders, enabling the right response when every second counts.

As our solution has grown from a small startup to one of the leading offerings for Fire & Police agencies, our customers now trust us to solve more of their problems. We are building new products to increase the safety and efficiency of emergency response agencies, and shaping the way we interact with those agencies, to ultimately help our customers save lives.

Job Description

This role is primarily remote with travel to our offices and customer sites.

This position is within the Guardian Deployment Team. The role of the Business Analyst, with specific experience of Emergency Services Control Room operations, is to facilitate the deployment of a Motorola Solutions Control Room Solution (Guardian Suite) to a strategic customer, or potentially a number of customers.

The role is remote based with frequent travel to their strategic customers and occasional visits to our Motorola Solutions offices. We estimate that there is an up to 50% travel requirement. At specific events such as customer Go Live there will be a requirement to work outside of usual business hours and be on site for up to 5 days at a time.

The post holder will be part of a Guardian deployment team appointed to a project of strategic importance to the company. They will be asked to support the deployment to a number of customers by engaging directly with end-users as well as other stakeholders in the agency to identify how to use and how Guardian fits into their agency workflow and/or help them amend their workflow to support usage of Guardian.

The Principal role (accountability) of the Business Analyst is to establish an operational relationship with the designated project and operational personnel of the assigned multiple customers, typically Police, Fire and Rescue, or other Emergency Services. Working with the customer to develop and maintain the documentation relating to business benefits realisation. The Business Analyst is responsible for the satisfaction of the customer.

Typical Activities Of a Business Analyst Will Include

Being the operational process subject matter expert for the customers.
Completion of requirement gap analysis during the pre-contract phase or within contract change processes. Delivering a RAG status for any functional requirements for use within integration or software development.
The Business Analyst will be the deployment teams Principal contact for the Engineering and Product team tracking progress of software development.
Capturing and documenting customer requirements and acceptance criteria with clarity of what is being delivered within the deployment and then within live service
Capturing and documenting supplier requirements to ensure these meet the customer expectations and that any gap analysis of the supplier products are identified early and a roadmap for development is managed with that supplier product team
Completion of training needs analysis with their customers and ensuring the customer has clarity on the training offered under the contract.
Delivery of train the trainer courses, facilitate any supplier training courses and support the customer with delivery of end user training courses
Support the test events managed by the Software Test Engineers and associated defect management process
Support the customer with on site support, where appropriate, for major events like Go Live of Guardian products/services, software upgrades and system outages.
Produce or update, with clarity, user stories and acceptance criteria for the Product and/or Engineering team and Suppliers to resolve software defects
Support the service management team and where applicable manage any software defects creating incidents or problems in live service
Assist the Programme Manager and Technical Design Authority in the production of pre-sales solution and deployment proposals, such as documentation of a new Motorola Solutions solution design to meet a set of Customer requirements.

The post holder will demonstrate the following competencies whilst working for Motorola Solutions as Guardian Business Analyst:

Developing and maintaining outstanding understanding of the product being delivered to the customers and the operational processes the product is being used to as part of the large and complex software solutions being delivered to their assigned customers.
High level of relationship awareness, building long term positive relationships with deployment and service team members, customers (project and operational), key suppliers and customer stakeholders including 3rd party integration suppliers
Excellent communication skills - written and verbal - being able to translate technical information into operational level communication effectively for any customer, product team or supplier
Experience in Agile software development. Working effectively as the pivotal role between customer and product development teams ensuring the released software meets the user requirement and passes acceptance testing with minimal re-engineering or workarounds being employed by customers
Experience of working with multiple customers across agencies
Experience of working within project teams delivering large and complex software solutions to customers in the emergency services
Awareness of the commercial implications of deliveries and the commercial impact of operational issues being experienced by customers

Strong experience of call taker and dispatch operations in the emergency services

Experience of software deployment to UK bluelight (police and/or fire - particularly the Control Room space) agencies

Knowledge of project management principles - with certification or working towards certification

In Return For Your Expertise, We’ll Support You In This New Challenge With Coaching & Development Every Step Of The Way. Also, To Reward Your Hard Work You’ll Get

new_jobs.description:
About The Role

Airports and venues are Uber's highest-stakes customer experience moments. Airports alone account for approximately 15% of Uber's Mobility Gross Bookings globally - a disproportionate share driven by our premium portfolio, high-value riders, and the structural complexity of airport operations across 100+ priority hubs worldwide. On a platform completing more than 40 million trips every day, airport journeys punch well above their weight: they disproportionately shape how business travelers, tourists, and premium users perceive Uber. A single poor experience at a priority hub doesn't just generate a support ticket; it drives churn among the cohort most likely to be first-trip riders, most likely to upgrade to premium products, and most likely to become long-term brand advocates.

The Airports & Venues CX program owns the global strategy to eliminate that friction at scale. We sit at the intersection of Ops, Product, and CX - translating on-the-ground airport complexity (staging lots, regulatory constraints, fare structures, matching algorithms, wayfinding failures) into systemic, data-driven solutions that reduce defects across the top 100+ priority airports worldwide including venues.

As Program Manager, Airports & Venues CX
, you will own the global defect reduction program - the most consequential initiative within this domain. You are the person who understands what is driving each basis point of airport defect rates across key issues such as fare disputes, cancellations, lost items or transaction issues at our priority hubs, and builds the cross-functional machine that surfaces customer insights, quantifies root causes drives and advocates for product and on ground improvements to bring that number down - structurally, not episodically.

This role is ideal for a senior CX, support operations, product operations, or travel operations leader who combines analytical rigor, customer empathy, AI fluency, and deep comfort operating in complex physical environments such as airports, airlines, mobility platforms, hospitality, logistics, or large-scale venues.

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

We are currently seeking a talented Competitive Intelligence Analyst Lead
to serve as a key business partner in providing a view of the Annuity Business
competitive landscape and industry trends. This role will research and analyze the competition and product mix, identifies and communicates trends, competitive forces, and penetration/segmentation strategies to make informed assumptions to determine probability of different scenarios. Then translate findings into recommendations that proactively drive operational, tactical, innovative and strategic business decisions to consult with management on competitive intelligence issues.

This role goes beyond traditional competitive intelligence and market reporting. As a trusted advisor to the Annuity leadership team, Competitive Intelligence Lead
will bring an outside-in perspective to help USAA evaluate how competitors are evolving and where we can differentiate to create greater member value and accelerate business growth. The role will monitor and assess emerging product innovations, marketing and positioning strategies, technology investments, sales and service enhancements, distribution trends, and broader industry developments.

Success in this position requires the ability to synthesize diverse market signals into actionable business implications, challenge conventional thinking, and influence leadership decisions. Rather than simply reporting what happened in the marketplace, this role will proactively identify what matters most, anticipate where the industry is heading, and help shape the strategies that position USAA for long-term success in the annuity market.

We offer a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be in the office 4 days per week. This position will be based on the San Antonio, TX (Preferred); Phoenix, AZ; Colorado Springs, CO; Plano, TX; Charlotte, NC; or Tampa Campus. Relocation assistance NOT
available for this position.

What You'll Do

Promotes and applies expert competitive intelligence analytical methodologies to address industry issues.
Proactively identifies issues of concern, proposes recommended solutions and participates in implementing.
Leads large scale, highly complex, competitive analysis projects that are without a clear or standard path and include data analysis, competitor research, market developments and predictive analytics
May collaborate with cross-functions teams to identify and define the underlying business issue.
Facilitates the development, design, analysis and execution of the project.
Applies an expert level of knowledge in competitive intelligence research, and continually collect and analyze relevant market and industry data, competitive and customer information to identify actionable intelligence
Interprets complex research data and findings into business strategies, advises senior management on issues and presents findings to various levels of leadership.
Mentors efforts of less experienced peers and team members and provides input on performance appraisals.
Researches and identifies industry best practices and trends to increase effectiveness and shares best practices with team.
Maintains and applies expert knowledge of the business, its products and processes, and expert knowledge of competitive intelligence research and analytic methodologies.
Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.

What You Have

Bachelor’s degree OR 4 years of related education and/or experience (in addition to the minimum years of experience required) may be substituted in lieu of degree. (Total of 12 years of experience without bachelor’s degree)
8 years of experience in business development, market research and analysis/modeling, product management, business analysis and/or competitive intelligence.
Ability to think strategically and translate analytic findings into actionable competitive insights.
Experience with qualitative and quantitative research skills, including data analysis, data synthesis, SWOT analysis, and data driven recommendations.
Advanced skills in researching and analyzing market insights using databases and analytical processes for customer/marketing-related analytics.
Knowledge of risk management and compliance frameworks and experience with leveraging market intelligence data to provide insights on risk mitigation.

What Sets You Apart

8+ years of competitive intelligence, market intelligence, product strategy, consulting, or related experience within the life insurance and annuity industry.
Deep understanding of annuity products, product management, distribution channels, carrier economics, and market dynamics.
Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives through data-driven insights and strategic recommendations.
Experience translating competitive intelligence into business actions that improved growth, market position, member experience, or operational performance.
Strong understanding of competitor product development, pricing strategies, marketing approaches, sales models, and digital capabilities.
Proficiency using industry intelligence platforms such as Wink, Morningstar Annuity Intelligence, Beacon, LIMRA, Competiscan, and Annuity Rate Watch.
Ability to analyze competitor filings, earnings calls, product launches, regulatory developments, and industry trends to identify strategic implications.
Established network and relationships within the annuity and retirement income industry.
Exceptional storytelling, executive presentation, and PowerPoint communication skills, with the ability to distill complex insights into concise and compelling recommendations.
Proven ability to operate independently, lead ambiguous strategic initiatives, and influence decisions across multiple leadership levels.
US military experience through military service or as a military spouse/domestic partner.

Compensation range:
The salary range for this position is: $114,080 - $218,030

USAA does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Please do not apply for this role if at any time (now or in the future) you will need immigration support (i.e., H-1B, TN, STEM OPT Training Plans, etc.).

Compensation:
USAA has an effective process for assessing market data and establishing ranges to ensure we remain competitive. You are paid within the salary range based on your experience and market data of the position. The actual salary for this role may vary by location.

Employees may be eligible for pay incentives based on overall corporate and individual performance and at the discretion of the USAA Board of Directors.

The above description reflects the details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job and should not be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be performed in the job.

Benefits:
At USAA our employees enjoy best-in-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellness. These benefits include comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans, 401(k), pension, life insurance, parental benefits, adoption assistance, paid time off program with paid holidays plus 16 paid volunteer hours, and various wellness programs. Additionally, our career path planning and continuing education assists employees with their professional goals.

For more details on our outstanding benefits, visit our benefits page on USAAjobs.com.

Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis, this posting will remain open until the position is filled. Thus, interested candidates are encouraged to apply the same day they view this posting.

USAA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

new_jobs.title: INFORMATION SECURITY ANALYST II
new_jobs.description:
Salary Is Based On Experience, Skills, And Education

This position is 100% onsite

The Marvin Group is a Strategic Partner for Global Alternate Mission Equipment and Sustainment

The Marvin Group, a leading defense contractor, plays a crucial role in the development and manufacturing of various systems for military aerospace and vehicles. Based in Southern California near the Los Angeles International Airport, The Marvin Group consists of Marvin Engineering (MEC), Marvin Test Solutions (MTS) and Marvin Land Systems (MLS). Marvin Engineering designs and produces military Alternate Mission Equipment. Marvin Test Solutions designs and manufactures armament Test Equipment. Marvin Land Systems specializes in the design and build of power and thermal management systems. For over 60 years we have maintained “A Tradition of Excellence”, serving as a trusted source for our unwavering commitment to supporting all branches of the Department of Defense and our global allies. Our collaboration extends across a diverse array of programs and platforms, including major military prime contractors such as Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, and Raytheon.

Position Summary

The Information Security Analyst II at the Marvin Group will be responsible for monitoring and protecting the organization from all vectors of cyber-attacks including and not limited to network, hardware, software, cloud, E-Mail, insider threat and other forms of potential infiltrations and hackers. This position requires the analyst to actively respond to and quell cyberattacks. The ideal Information Security Analyst II has experience in Endpoint Security, Network Security, and experience using industry tools designed to keep an organization safe.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Safeguards information system assets by identifying and solving potential and actual security problems.
Implements security improvements by assessing current situation; evaluating trends; anticipating requirements.
Upgrades system by implementing and maintaining security controls.
Monitor systems and networks for security threats
Conduct audits and risk assessments
Develop and implement security policies and procedures
Keeps users informed by preparing performance reports, communicating system status.
Collaborate with IT teams to secure infrastructure
Recognizes problems by identifying abnormalities, reporting violations
Ensuring that fellow employees are following proper security practices, which may include direct engagement.

Skills And Requirements

Basic security certification or cyber security related certification, or equivalent education or work experience
Information security policies
Vulnerability assessments and risk analysis
Cybersecurity Compliance Frameworks
SIEM Tools
Cloud Security
System administration
Network security
Endpoint security
Problem solving
Exercises good judgement
Solid understanding of Network protocols
Process improvement
On-call network troubleshooting
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
Excellent communication skills (especially for non-technical audiences)
Ability to work independently and in cross-functional teams
Attention to detail and adaptability
Flexible Working hours

Work Environment

Medium-to-large office environment
Fast paced office environment
The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate
Exposed to a combination of normal office type environments

Salary Range

Base Salary Range (Inglewood only): $90,000 to $120,000

Travel Requirements

There are typically no travel requirements for this position (0%)

new_jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Data Analyst promotes the integrity of Patterson’s data across the enterprise, ensuring the data can support transactional processes and analytical reporting. The Data Analyst is the business liaison in understanding the data requirements, definition, and downstream use and business impacts. In addition, he or she will work closely with technical partners, business stakeholders and data stewards/ maintainers to ensure needs are clearly defined and met by data.

Essential Functions

To perform this job successfully, an employee must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily, with or without reasonable accommodation. To request a reasonable accommodation, notify Human Resources or the manager who oversees the position.

Understand, maintain and enforce enterprise data definition and uses (metadata), for example: Build a data definition and align the definition across business units
Create data requirements and data mapping documents for business processes or technology projects
Assist in designing master data entry business processes with data stewards to improve operational efficiencies
Analyze data and recommend improvements for efficiency / quality
Research and recommend process or technology improvements for the quality of data being created or used (ex: Automated workflow process)
Define data quality evaluation tools to enable end users to assess data quality and improve data quality (ex: Info Steward reports / dashboard)
Document data definition or data entry processes to assist with training activities and support data entry teams

Additional Functions

Perform other duties as assigned.

Job Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in MIS, IT, Computer Science or related field of study, or equivalent combination of education and experience
At least 2 years of experience in data analysis
Experience with Master Data Management solutions; preferred Informatica P360/C360
Attention to detail and accuracy when dealing with large amounts of data
Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing
Customer-focused and collaborative attitude

Preferred Qualifications

Data Management tool experience specific to Information Steward and Govern 360
Automation experience specific to Automate Evolve
SQL or other comparable language aptitude
SAP experience, especially ECC or S/4

Working Conditions

Physical Demands

Operating a computer or other office devices for the majority of the workday
May occasionally need to move packages up to 10 pounds such as office supplies or equipment

Environmental Factors

This position is in an office environment in which team members occupy desks in assigned areas or at meeting/collaboration spaces within the building. The building’s primary work areas consist of desks, chairs, computers and other office equipment and devices for professional services.

Travel and On-call

This position requires minimal travel (10%) in a national area. For this position being on-call is not required.

Responsibilities

Develop user stories and features from analysis models
Create viable specifications and acceptance criteria by ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and relevance of requirements
Liaise between multiple business and technology teams to analyze and assess system functionality and capabilities

Identify opportunities to improve technology systems that positively impact the business and participate in developing innovative approaches and solutions to resolve issues

Skills And Experience

Strong computer literacy including effective working skills of Microsoft Visio, Word, Excel and PowerPoint, Project

Application development teams on custom built applications

Previous system integration projects
Azure DevOps

Written and verbal French and English language skills, due to frequent collaboration with English-speaking teams/clients across Canada and some client deliverables/regulatory reporting obligation are in English

With a focus on high-potential earnings, MNP is proud to offer customized rewards that support our unique culture and a balanced lifestyle to thrive at work and outside of the office. You will be rewarded with generous base pay, vacation time, 4 paid personal days, a group pension plan with 4% matching, voluntary savings products, bonus programs, flexible benefits, mental health resources, exclusive access to perks and discounts, professional development assistance, MNP University, a flexible ‘Dress For Your Day’ environment, firm sponsored social events and more!

Proven ability to operate independently, lead ambiguous strategic initiatives, and influence decisions across multiple leadership levels.

competitive landscape and industry trends. Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.

Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.

Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at www.sophos.com .

Overview

The SE Operations Analyst plays a key role in supporting the productivity, visibility, and operational integrity of the Sales Engineering (SE) organization. This role is a great fit for someone with strong Salesforce (SFDC) and reporting skills who also brings some hands-on experience with AI tools — and who’s excited to keep building those AI skills as we apply them to real operational and reporting work.

The analyst will initially focus primarily on maintaining and enhancing SE Power BI dashboards, ensuring reporting accuracy, usability, and alignment with requirements defined by SE leadership and the SalesOps Power BI team. In addition, this role provides hands-on support for Salesforce (SFDC) — including our SFDC-based SE toolset ( Vivun ) — and various SE operational workflows including quota-related data preparation. This role acts as the first line of support for day-to-day SFDC (including our Vivun toolset) troubleshooting and change requests, escalating complex or strategic issues to the SE Systems & Enablement lead.

This is a collaborative, execution-focused role — you’ll build on the SFDC and reporting processes already in place, help extend our AI-enabled workflows, and contribute directly to the SFDC/ Vivun operations work the team has already started.

What You Will Do

Data Visualization & Reporting

Maintain and enhance existing Power BI dashboards and datasets that support SE performance metrics, activity reporting, and leadership visibility.
Implement updates and improvements based on direction from SE leadership and in alignment with SalesOps reporting standards.
Validate data sources and ensure data integrity across recurring and ad hoc reports.
Support simple analyses (e.g., trends, productivity indicators, POC volume, regional comparisons) to help SE leaders understand operational patterns.
Assist with preparation of data inputs used for SE quota planning and annual planning cycles.

Systems & Process Support

Own first-line triage, logging, and coordination of Salesforce (SFDC) change requests and troubleshooting (including our Vivun toolset — e.g., access issues, field/data problems) for the SE team, escalating complex or strategic changes to the SE Systems & Enablement lead.
Support basic SFDC/ Vivun administration tasks, such as data hygiene, user support, and reporting needs.
Document business requirements for small system enhancements and collaborate with SalesOps or  IT on  implementation steps.
Maintain and update process documentation for SE operational workflows and tools.
Serve as first -line responder for day-to-day SFDC (including our Vivun toolset) usage questions from the SE team, building and maintaining a self-service FAQ/knowledge base to reduce repeat requests over time.
Support the SE Systems & Enablement lead by handling routine reactive support work directly, freeing senior team members to focus on strategic initiatives and escalated issues.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with the SalesOps Power BI team to ensure SE dashboards follow established data models, definitions, and governance.
Collaborate with SE managers to understand reporting needs and translate them into defined dashboard updates or data improvement tasks.
Partner with SalesOps, IT, and other stakeholders on small projects that improve SE operational efficiency or data quality.

AI & Future Systems — A Growth Area for This Role

Apply AI-assisted tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, workflow automation) to streamline reporting, ticket triage, and documentation where appropriate .
Contribute to early data preparation and exploratory reporting in Snowflake as part of the team’s planned internal system updates .
Support integration between Salesforce, Snowflake, and Power BI as the SE data platform evolves.

What You Will Bring

Required

3+ years of experience in data analysis, operations, or business systems support.
Some hands-on experience with AI-assisted tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, workflow automation), and genuine interest in continuing to build AI skills and apply them to reporting and operational work.
Practical hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI, including building dashboards, measures, and basic data modeling.
Hands-on familiarity with Salesforce (SFDC) data structures and reporting concepts, with comfort making or coordinating basic configuration changes (e.g., fields, layouts, list views).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to translate data into simple explanations.
Ability to work collaboratively with guidance and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to Have

Exposure to Salesforce managed-package tools (e.g., Vivun ), Snowflake, Tableau, or similar reporting/data-platform tools.
Basic knowledge of SQL, Power Query, or DAX.
Experience supporting Sales Engineering, Sales Operations, or similar GTM organizations.
Understanding of CRM data flows or opportunity lifecycle concepts.
Interest in or exposure to building internal systems/tools — this role may contribute to an internal platform that eventually replaces our current SFDC add-on ( Vivun ).

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field; or equivalent professional experience.

Core Attributes

Experienced professional who identifies and completes complex assignments with direct impact on the function or business unit.
Receives little guidance on work; is guided by the objectives of the project or ongoing assignments; plans own work priorities on a regular basis.
Builds productive relationships and contributes to team effectiveness through reliable execution.
Operates with growing autonomy on recurring troubleshooting, tickets, and reporting tasks, escalating novel, complex, or strategic issues to the SE Systems & Enablement lead.

Role Name: Business Analyst - GTM (Go-To-Market)

At Kapture CX, we are looking for a Business Analyst in our GTM team

Who are we?

Kapture CX is a leading SaaS platform that helps enterprises automate and elevate customer experience through intelligent, AI-powered solutions. We partner with enterprises across industries to bring scalable automation and insight-driven efficiencies to their CX operations.

Over a thousand clients across 18 countries have used Kapture’s products to enhance their customer experience, including Unilever, Reliance, Coca-Cola, BigBasket, Meesho, Airtel Payments Bank, and Cathay Pacific. Kapture delivers industry-specific solutions powered by AI, tailored workflows, and seamless automation.

Kapture CX is headquartered in Bangalore, with offices in Mumbai and Delhi/NCR, as well as international offices across the USA, UAE, Singapore, Philippines, and Indonesia.

What is this role all about?

At Kapture CX, our GTM team drives strategic expansion, revenue execution, and operational efficiency across growth and customer-facing functions. As a Business Analyst - GTM, you will work on high-impact initiatives, taking ownership of projects end-to-end while driving program management and business analytics to optimize Go-To-Market execution.

Rather than managing routine operational tickets, you will lead end-to-end GTM projects, streamline cross-functional programs, leverage data to deliver actionable insights, and build scalable workflows that help leadership make smarter decisions.

Sounds interesting?

Here's a more detailed description of what you will do in this role:

End-to-End Project & Program Management: Own and execute strategic GTM projects from conception to completion, ensuring alignment across cross-functional teams, clear milestone tracking, and timely delivery.
Business Analytics & Insights: Conduct deep-dive business analytics across GTM data, customer journeys, and operational metrics to deliver dashboards, reports, and insights that support leadership decision-making.
Workflow & Process Optimization: Analyze GTM and customer-facing operational workflows to identify bottlenecks, streamline cross-departmental handoffs, and design scalable, data-driven solutions.
AI & Automation Integration: Build and implement AI-powered tools such as knowledge assistants, chatbots, and workflow copilots to improve team productivity.
Cross-Functional Ownership: Lead strategic cross-functional programs (e.g., Customer360, Self-Service Portals, Enablement) by owning analysis, documentation, and execution workstreams.

This is a Bangalore-based role.
We work five days a week from the office, as we believe in-person collaboration drives innovation and faster execution.

new_jobs.title: Deal Strategy Analyst - EMEA
new_jobs.description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

The Deal Strategy Analyst is a commercial operator embedded in Synthesia's Revenue Operations function. This is a deal desk role with depth — you’ll partner directly with AE/CSMs, Sales leadership, Finance, and Legal across the EMEA region to structure, price, and approve deals that are commercially sound, operationally clean, and built to close.

You will support the deal review process for EMEA: from first submission through approval routing, exception triage, and post-signature hygiene. You’re a day-to-day partner to AE/CSMs on standard deals, escalating non-standard structures to senior team members.

We are looking for someone with strong technical foundations — Salesforce fluency, revenue recognition awareness, and comfort working in CPQ environments — alongside developing commercial judgement and a willingness to learn the craft of deal structuring.

What You'll Do

Deal Review & Structuring

Review deal submissions from EMEA AE/CSMs for compliance with pricing policy, discount schedules, and approval thresholds — approving standard deals and routing exceptions to senior reviewers
Support modelling of multi-year, multi-product deals — building ARR, TCV, and per-seat/platform fee scenarios under the guidance of senior team members
Spot common commercial risks in deal structures and flag them to senior team members or the Manager for review
Triage exception requests, gather supporting context from the AE/CSM, and prepare them for review by senior team members with clear documentation

Commercial Operations & Systems

Manage deal data integrity in Salesforce — ensuring opportunity records, pricing fields, and approval audit trails are accurate and complete
Work within DealHub (CPQ) to validate deal configurations, flag misconfigurations, and escalate system issues during the deal review workflow
Support ARR and revenue recognition hygiene by flagging deal structures that may create recognition complexity for senior review
Assist with maintaining Deal Desk playbooks, floor pricing references, and discount schedule documentation

Stakeholder Partnership

Act as a first point of contact for EMEA AE/CSMs on standard commercial queries and deal submission questions, escalating senior or complex requests as needed
Coordinate with Finance and Legal on routine deal questions, escalating non-standard commercial terms or booking issues to senior team members
Communicate approval decisions clearly — explaining the why, not just the outcome, and building AE/CSM trust through consistency and speed
Manage inbound deal desk cases from the EMEA field — triaging requests from AE/CSMs via the shared deal desk mailbox, tracking case status, and ensuring SLAs are met for standard submissions

Process Ownership

Maintain deal log accuracy, hit SLAs consistently, and surface observations on recurring approval patterns to the Manager
Flag recurring exceptions to the Director that may signal a gap in the approval framework
Help roll out new commercial policies into the EMEA field by maintaining documentation and supporting enablement sessions

What We're Looking For

Experience & Technical Skills

At least 2 years of experience in a Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or commercial finance role in a B2B SaaS company
Hands-on Salesforce experience — you can navigate opportunity records, run reports, and maintain deal data accuracy without hand-holding
Familiarity with CPQ systems (DealHub, Salesforce CPQ, or similar) — you understand how deal configurations map to pricing outputs
Working knowledge of revenue recognition principles (ASC 606 / IFRS 15) — enough to identify when a deal structure creates a recognition issue and escalate appropriately
Comfort building and interpreting deal models in Excel or Google Sheets — ARR/TCV splits, multi-year commit scenarios, discount waterfall logic

What You'll Bring

Working understanding of SaaS commercial mechanics: ARR, TCV, per-seat pricing, platform fees, multi-year discounting.
Clear, confident communicator — comfortable fielding questions from AE/CSMs and asking for help when a deal is outside your remit.
Highly organised with a low error rate on repetitive, process-driven tasks.
Proactive by default — you flag problems early rather than waiting to be asked.
EMEA-based and comfortable spanning UK, DACH, Nordics, and broader European deal cycles.

Nice To Have

Experience with CLM platforms (Ironclad, LinkSquares, Luminance, or similar)
Exposure to AWS Marketplace or other cloud marketplace deal mechanics
Experience supporting a Deal Desk or RevOps tooling implementation
Familiarity with NetSuite for order management or billing workflows
Knowledge of EMEA-specific commercial nuances: GDPR data processing terms, EU procurement cycles, local PO and invoicing requirements
